run_pytorch_microbenchmark_from_file: run a PyTorch operator microbenchmark by passing a JSON config file path with the --file flag
run_pytorch_microbenchmark_from_shared_m: run a PyTorch operator microbenchmark by passing a shared memory buffer name with the --shm flag
run_pytorch_microbenchmark_verbose: run a PyTorch operator microbenchmark with debug logging enabled using the --verbose flag
build_op_config: build an operator configuration using make_op_config with an op name, op info, and device
execute_materialized_build: execute a MaterializedBuildExecutor run with an op config, build input config, and config build ID
